pages.title: Fed and Content
pages.text: Different safe meals support continued resident diet care.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Stock suitable food and leave a real access route. Variety and desired dishes affect quality; harmful meals worsen state. Food sitting in a chest is not proof the resident ate.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Satiety, safety, variety and desired food matter; harmful food does not improve mood.
